title_working: In This World, Your Number Shows How Important You Will Become
world_rule: Every child is born with a number above the head that shows how important they will become.
logline: The boy born with zero saves everyone from a school fire, last of all his best friend, and his number turns to infinity.

lines.text: In this world, your number shows how important you will become.
lines.say: (confident) In this world, your number shows how important you will become.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Every child is born with one, floating right above their head.
lines.say: (happy) Every child is born with one, floating right above their head.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Some kids get twelve. Some get forty-five. A few even get nine hundred.
lines.say: (happy) Some kids get twelve. Some get forty-five. A few even get nine hundred.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My best friend Mason was born with twelve hundred and four.
lines.say: (happy) My best friend Mason was born with twelve hundred and four.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone knew he would grow up to be someone big.
lines.say: (happy) Everyone knew he would grow up to be someone big.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But when I was born, the doctor looked at my number and went completely silent.
lines.say: (nervous) But when I was born, the doctor looked at my number and went completely silent.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Growing up, everyone treated me like I would never matter.
lines.say: (sad) Growing up, everyone treated me like I would never matter.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: At school, the kids with big numbers were treated like celebrities.
lines.say: (sad) At school, the kids with big numbers were treated like celebrities.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I tried everything to raise mine. I studied harder. I helped people. I even won competitions.
lines.say: (confident) I tried everything to raise mine. I studied harder. I helped people. I even won competitions.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then one day, a fire broke out at school.
lines.say: (nervous) Then one day, a fire broke out at school.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone panicked. Students were trapped inside.
lines.say: (nervous) Everyone panicked. Students were trapped inside.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I ran inside to help. One by one, I pulled them out.
lines.say: (confident) I ran inside to help. One by one, I pulled them out.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The very last one was Mason.
lines.say: (soft tone) The very last one was Mason.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: When he was finally safe, I looked up and saw that my number had changed.
lines.say: (soft tone) When he was finally safe, I looked up and saw that my number had changed.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It was not zero anymore. It was infinity.
lines.say: (happy) It was not zero anymore. It was infinity.
lines.speaker: narrator
